rows.text: Culture adherent cells in a vessel until confluent.
rows.why: Culture, rinse and enzyme detachment of adherent cells in a vessel, done off chip.

rows.text: Remove the medium and rinse the cells once with buffer.
rows.why: Culture, rinse and enzyme detachment of adherent cells in a vessel, done off chip.

rows.text: Add dissociation enzyme and incubate to detach the cells.
rows.why: Culture, rinse and enzyme detachment of adherent cells in a vessel, done off chip.

rows.text: Add quench medium and mix gently to stop the enzyme.
rows.why: Quench, centrifuge and wash are done at the bench with the centrifuge.

rows.text: Centrifuge the cells and remove the supernatant.
rows.why: Quench, centrifuge and wash are done at the bench with the centrifuge.

rows.text: Resuspend the pellet in wash buffer and wash again (two washes in total).
rows.why: Quench, centrifuge and wash are done at the bench with the centrifuge.

rows.text: Pass the suspension through a cell strainer.
rows.need: pillar filter with about 30 um gap (0.75 x the encapsulation nozzle) for cells upstream of the junction
rows.why: A 30 um gap is below the smallest gap the process makes (60 um).
rows.workaround: Strain the cells off chip with a 30-40 um cell strainer before loading chip 1.

rows.text: Count the cells and check viability.
rows.why: Counting and viability check are done at the bench.

rows.text: Resuspend the cells in core solution at the loading density.
rows.why: Resuspending in core solution is a pipette step before loading the syringe for chip 1.

rows.text: Co-flow the cell/core solution with warm shell polymer solution and focus with fluorinated oil at a flow-focusing junction to make droplets.

phases.title: Encapsulate (co-flow)
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 2 uL/min (cells_in_core_solution); shell_polymer_in 2 uL/min (shell_polymer); fluorinated_oil_in 10 uL/min (fluorinated_oil) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: steady droplet break-up at droplets_1 (microscope); droplets travel on towards outlet_1; no oil backing up into the core line; keep shell_polymer_in (shell_polymer) warm (37 C syringe heater) up to the chip; the cold zone starts downstream; collect into the tube labelled 'chip1_encapsulation: droplets after step 10, for chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter inlet_1'

rows.text: Hand-off out of chip1_encapsulation (droplets): collect it from outlet_1 of chip1_encapsulation into a tube, then do bench step(s) 11.
Collect the emulsion and keep it on ice so the shell gels.
rows.why: The emulsion is gelled on the cold plate off chip. A 30 min delay line would not fit a 30 x 20 mm chip.

rows.text: Hand-off into chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter (droplets): load the tube into the syringe on inlet_1 of chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter (the sample line for chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter's first step).
Add emulsion-breaking agent and remove the oil phase.

phases.title: Load droplets from the hand-off from chip1_encapsulation
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 5 uL/min (droplets_sample) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the droplets arrives in capsule_trap and stays there; liquid leaves at trap_waste_out

phases.title: Exchange: emulsion_breaking_agent
phases.ports: FEED emulsion_breaking_agent_in 5 uL/min (emulsion_breaking_agent) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: emulsion_breaking_agent reaches capsule_trap and leaves at trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber

rows.text: Photocure the capsule shells with 405 nm light in the presence of photoinitiator.

phases.title: Exchange: photoinitiator
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (photoinitiator) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: photoinitiator reaches capsule_trap and leaves at trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Cure (405 nm)
phases.watch: 405 nm light over capsule_trap for 30 s; nothing flows

rows.text: Wash the capsules in buffer to remove oil and free reagents.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer x3
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches capsule_trap and leaves at trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

rows.text: Filter the capsules through a strainer to remove aggregates.

phases.title: Pass through
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (carrier_buffer) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: material moves from capsule_trap through aggregate_filter towards outlet_1; streams merge evenly; no clogging; collect into the tube labelled 'chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter: capsules after step 15, for chip3_lysis_wash_rt inlet_1'

rows.text: Hand-off chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter → chip3_lysis_wash_rt (capsules): move the outlet_1 tubing of chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter to inlet_1 of chip3_lysis_wash_rt; keep every other port of both chips capped.
Exchange the buffer for lysis buffer and incubate the capsules.

phases.title: Load capsules from the hand-off from chip2_emulsion_break_curing_wash_filter
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (capsules_sample) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: the capsules arrives in lysis_rt_trap and stays there; liquid leaves at trap_waste_out

phases.title: Exchange: lysis_buffer
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (lysis_buffer) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: lysis_buffer reaches lysis_rt_trap and leaves at trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Incubate
phases.watch: temperature steady at 22 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

rows.text: Wash the capsules in wash buffer.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer x3
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches lysis_rt_trap and leaves at trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

rows.text: Exchange the buffer for reverse transcription mix and incubate the capsules.

phases.title: Exchange: rt_mix
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (rt_mix) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: rt_mix reaches lysis_rt_trap and leaves at trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Incubate
phases.watch: temperature steady at 42 C; nothing moving; capped ports not leaking

rows.text: Wash the capsules twice.

phases.title: Exchange: wash_buffer x2
phases.ports: FEED inlet_1 20 uL/min (wash_buffer) | VENT trap_waste_out | rest capped
phases.watch: wash_buffer reaches lysis_rt_trap and leaves at trap_waste_out; no bubbles in the chamber; capsules stay on the mesh

phases.title: Collect the capsules (outlet_1)
phases.ports: FEED reagent_line_in 20 uL/min (collection_buffer) | VENT outlet_1 | rest capped
phases.watch: the capsules leaves lysis_rt_trap through outlet_1 into the tube labelled 'chip3_lysis_wash_rt: capsules after step 19'; never to waste

rows.text: Split the capsules into four equal portions.
rows.why: Index PCR reaches 95 C, above the 50 C limit of the printed resin. The capsules are split into four portions by pipette and cycled in the thermocycler, each with its own index primer mix.

rows.text: Run index PCR on each portion with a different index primer mix.
rows.why: Index PCR reaches 95 C, above the 50 C limit of the printed resin. The capsules are split into four portions by pipette and cycled in the thermocycler, each with its own index primer mix.

rows.text: Release the cDNA by digesting the capsule shells with shell-digesting enzyme.
rows.why: Shell digestion is done at the bench by pipette after PCR.

rows.text: Bind the library to magnetic beads.
rows.why: Bead binding, ethanol washes and elution are done as a bench kit. The lab has no magnet.

rows.text: Wash the beads with ethanol wash solution on a magnet.
rows.why: Bead binding, ethanol washes and elution are done as a bench kit. The lab has no magnet.

rows.text: Elute the library from the beads in water.
rows.why: Bead binding, ethanol washes and elution are done as a bench kit. The lab has no magnet.

rows.text: Measure library concentration and fragment size.
rows.why: Library concentration and fragment size are measured on bench instruments.
